notes: Cross-verse reconciliation with ECC.9.13. The verse pass marked the supplied *come* `added` under rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause, while ECC.9.13 folds the equally supplied *seemed* into its predicate adjective as the construction's copula. Both clauses are verbless and both write their own predicate morpheme, so the difference rests only on which English verb the ASV chose. *come* is the linking verb this clause supplies where a copula would stand: it joins the predicate, giving the compound particle the whole of *come alike*, which rule 30 permits for an expression whose unit additionally carries a construction-supplied copula.
